name: verdict-store-shape
description: extensions/judge verdict store clones audit-store.ts: single table with UNIQUE dedupe_key + ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, rowid as export paging sequence, :memory: + injected now() for tests; write path re-runs wire.ts validateVerdict before DB touch so only §12.3-valid verdicts land.

Live-corpus analysis is the judge's real test suite: the first 64 gemini-3.7-flash verdicts were 98% clean/all-high-confidence, and joining them against run outcomes showed 3 of 4 dropped_commit runs judged clean even though reap.empty_push and failureReason were in the judge's context. Prompt salience, not missing data, was the defect — the rubric never said to reconcile the verdict against get_run_facts ground truth. Fixed in PR #970 by adding a mandatory reconciliation section (forks rubricVersion, re-judging the corpus).
resolution: PR #970 rubric reconciliation section + live redeploy

name: judge-cost-cap-tool-layer
description: Enforce per-judgment cost caps at the tool layer, not just between attempts: judge-loop's cap check only ran after failed attempts, so 19% of successful live judgments exceeded the $0.25 cap (max 3.6x). The fix threads a live getAccruedCostUsd closure (prior attempts + in-flight session stats) into page_events, which refuses transcript past the cap and tells the model to report from what it has — same soft-landing shape as the page cap, bounding overshoot to one model turn.

name: judge-budget-deferral-both-arms
description: Budget-gate semantics must match across every judgment arm: PR #969 made the collector defer (no marker) on daily-budget exhaustion, but the calibration arm kept writing budget_exceeded markers under the strong model id — which permanently excluded sampled runs from calibration because candidates skip any run with a strong-id row. PR #971 ported deferral to calibration before enabling it live; the first live pass (budget already spent by the re-drain) deferred all 10 samples with zero markers, proving the path. When a store's dedupe key doubles as a 'done' flag, any writer that records a non-retryable outcome on a retryable condition permanently burns the key.

name: judge-image-ci-set-image-only-roll
description: CI wiring for the judge extension image (warren-eecb, PR #972): deploy-gke.yml builds warren-ext-judge beside the three warren images (context extensions/judge alone, per extensions.md §2) and the deploy job rolls an EXISTING judge Deployment with 'kubectl set image' + rollout + live-image verify. set-image-only is the load-bearing choice: the gitignored gke-live-judge overlay owns provider/model/budget env and the imperatively created Secrets, so CI must never 'kubectl apply' the judge overlay (it would clobber judge-secrets with the template's REPLACE_ME values) and must skip cleanly when no Deployment exists (judge is opt-in; forks stay green). Manual-apply hazard: after a CI roll the local overlay's newTag is stale, refresh from the live Deployment first (warren-0028 class).

Judge 'malformed verdict' rows are mostly not model output problems: (1) calibration model openrouter/qwen/qwen3.8-max is blocked by the OpenRouter account data-policy setting (404 'No endpoints available matching your guardrail restrictions and data policy'), so every calibration judgment since 2026-08-21 failed at $0 in ~150ms and 551 runs got permanent malformed_verdict markers under the strong id, leaving the agreement metric at 0 pairs; (2) judgeRun only checks whether report_verdict was called, but pi's agent loop records provider errors on the assistant message (state.errorMessage, stopReason 'error') and goes idle without throwing, so any 401/404/5xx is labeled malformed_verdict with a fixed detail string and the real message is lost; (3) the telemetry judge tab fetches /verdicts.jsonl?limit=500 with no since, which pages OLDEST-first, so it renders ids 1-500 and its 'newest' failing rows are the first qwen markers from 08-21. Repro locally needs PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR pointed at an empty dir, because ~/.pi/agent/auth.json's stale openrouter key overrides OPENROUTER_API_KEY and returns 401 'API key expired'.
resolution: Diagnosed 2026-09-01, fixes proposed: allow the qwen endpoint in OpenRouter privacy settings or pick a calibration model the policy permits; make judgeRun read the session's errorMessage/stopReason and store it as judge_error with the message; skip writing a calibration marker when the attempt cost $0 (nothing billed) so the run stays sampleable; make the UI page newest rows (since = maxId - limit) instead of oldest.

description: calibration.ts sampleRuns pushed pool[i] captured BEFORE the Fisher-Yates swap, so every pass took the first sampleSize candidates in sorted order and the 'random sample' walked run ids alphabetically for 12 days (visible in the export: qwen markers and the first glm passes all start at run_00..., run_01...).
resolution: Fixed in 50701a08: push the element swapped into slot i, with a test whose entropy source always picks the tail so the old order fails.

title: Calibration leg is openrouter/z-ai/glm-5.3 (from qwen3.8-max)
rationale: qwen3.8-max is refused by the OpenRouter account data policy (404 at $0), so every calibration judgment since 2026-08-21 failed. glm-5.3 is policy-permitted, cheaper than qwen, and verified end-to-end through the judge loop.
